purpose: Settle whether the layer cost model or the plain run-count model generalizes better, so the shipped-model choice rests on a reproducible measurement rather than prose.
resampling: per-case cost drawn from its own CaseSpec run-count stratum, times U(0.9,1.1)
conclusion: under THIS resampling scheme (per-case cost drawn from its own CaseSpec run-count stratum, times U(0.9,1.1)), run-count wins the head-to-head (0.570 of draws for run-count). This is ONE scheme, not a general result: see cost_model_bootstrap_sensitivity.py, which shows the ordering flips under proportional noise. The shipped run-count model is chosen for simplicity, transparent provenance and derivability from the frozen case authority, NOT for a claimed robustness advantage.
